quotes.verbatim_quote:
The problems involve the interval of a diminished 4th. To be more specific, we're talk-

ing about B and Eb. A diminished 4th looks like a 4th on the staff. But the sound is a Major 3rd.
quotes.why_load_bearing: Defines the core enharmonic trap that makes some 3-part 4th voicings sound like triads.

quotes.verbatim_quote:
That is not to say that there is anything wrong with these voicings. It’s just that they
don’t work very well in a 4th voicings context.
quotes.why_load_bearing: Practical rule for when to avoid certain voicings in quartal context.

quotes.verbatim_quote:
Triads are 3-part chords based on tertial harmony (harmony derived from 3rds). 3-part
4ths are 3-part chords based on quartal harmony (harmony derived from 4ths). As it turns out,
tertial harmony and quartal harmony are pretty much exact opposites.
quotes.why_load_bearing: Conceptual definition that frames the entire system.

quotes.verbatim_quote:
Four 3rds, Two 4ths, One 5th, Two 6ths
Primary intervals: 3rds and 6ths
Secondary intervals: 4ths and 5ths
Color intervals: 2nds and 7ths (missing)
quotes.why_load_bearing: Interval taxonomy of triads — comparative baseline.

quotes.verbatim_quote:
Two 2nds, Four 4ths, Two 5ths, One 7th
Primary intervals: 4ths and 5ths
Secondary intervals: 2nds and 7ths
Color intervals: 3rds and 6ths (missing)
quotes.why_load_bearing: Interval taxonomy of 3-part 4ths — mirror-image proof of tertial/quartal opposition.

quotes.verbatim_quote:
Here's a really great thing to do that is very “guitar-friendly.” After you've spent some
time exploring the 3-part 4ths in C Major, tune the low E string down a whole step to D. Use
the low D string as a pedal, [you could also use the A string] and play through all the cycles!
quotes.why_load_bearing: Concrete guitar-specific drop-D pedal technique for 4th-voicing cycles.

quotes.verbatim_quote:
you’d be playing in D dorian mode; since there
aren’t any “avoid” notes in Dorian, pretty much anything and everything you play will work
very nicely!
quotes.why_load_bearing: Explains why drop-D Dorian pedal context is safe to explore freely.

quotes.verbatim_quote:
you might also consider the possibility of ARPEGGLIATING
the 4th voicings to arrive at WAY COOL melodies!
quotes.why_load_bearing: Extends 4th voicings from harmonic to melodic generation.
